targets.rawSql: SELECT tp.truck_id, tp.truck_status, dz.city AS current_zone_city, ST_Y(tp.geog::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(tp.geog::geometry) AS longitude, tp.updated_at FROM silver.truck_current_position tp LEFT JOIN reference.delivery_zones dz ON dz.zone_id = tp.current_zone_id

SELECT tp.truck_id, tp.truck_status, dz.city AS current_zone_city, (SELECT count(*) FROM silver.purchase_orders_current po WHERE po.truck_id = tp.truck_id AND po.status = 'in-transit') AS orders_aboard, tp.updated_at FROM silver.truck_current_position tp LEFT JOIN reference.delivery_zones dz ON dz.zone_id = tp.current_zone_id WHERE tp.truck_status != 'free' ORDER BY tp.updated_at DESC LIMIT 50
